# Band A atom vocabulary, met against every other, pinned in BOTH
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The algebra-law tests
# commutativity, idempotence, associativity and convergence, but each
# only compares an engine against ITSELF: two ports could normalise the
# same meet differently and still each be internally lawful. This file
# is the cross-port half -- the observable for every cell, run by both
# runners, so a normalisation that drifts in one port fails the shared
# Every row's expectation was PROBED through both engines and compared
# byte-for-byte before being pinned; all 256 agreed. The atom
# vocabulary is shared, one entry per line, in
# test/spec/files/constraint-atoms.txt -- both law tests read it, so
# Modes: `canon` where the meet has a residual or a value, `errc` where
# it is empty (code only -- message text is not in parity).

# pin only what agrees. A disagreement is a finding, not a row.
